cases.name: source-time-filter
cases.sql: SELECT observed_at_unix_nano AS time FROM observations WHERE length(observed_at_unix_nano) > 3 OR (length(observed_at_unix_nano) = 3 AND observed_at_unix_nano > '150')

cases.name: ordered-projection
cases.sql: SELECT observed_at_unix_nano AS time FROM observations ORDER BY length(observed_at_unix_nano), observed_at_unix_nano

cases.name: grouped-count
cases.sql: SELECT signal_name, count(*) AS samples FROM observations GROUP BY signal_name ORDER BY signal_name

cases.name: json-extraction
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload_json, '$.value') AS value FROM observations ORDER BY observation_sequence

cases.name: named-cte
cases.sql: WITH values_by_source AS (SELECT json_extract(payload_json, '$.value') AS value FROM observations) SELECT avg(value) AS average FROM values_by_source

cases.name: empty-with-types
cases.sql: SELECT signal_name, observation_id FROM observations WHERE 0

cases.name: int64-extremes
cases.sql: SELECT 9223372036854775807 AS largest, -9223372036854775808 AS smallest FROM observations LIMIT 1

cases.name: numeric-looking-text
cases.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload_json, '$.numeric') AS text_value FROM observations ORDER BY observation_sequence

cases.name: finite-non-finite
cases.sql: SELECT 1.5 AS finite, 1e999 AS infinity, -1e999 AS negative_infinity, 0.0 / 0.0 AS undefined, json_extract(payload_json, '$.bits') AS original_bits FROM observations WHERE json_extract(payload_json, '$.value') = 1

cases.name: null-missing-json
cases.sql: SELECT NULL AS null_value, json_extract(payload_json, '$.absent') AS missing, json_type(payload_json, '$.absent') AS missing_type FROM observations LIMIT 1

cases.name: division-overflow-collation
cases.sql: SELECT 1 / 2 AS quotient, 9223372036854775807 + 1 AS overflow, 'A' < 'a' COLLATE BINARY AS ordered FROM observations LIMIT 1

cases.name: duplicate-aliases
cases.sql: SELECT observation_id AS duplicate, signal_name AS duplicate FROM observations
